verdict.rationale: Letta offers conversation-level branching (/fork) and memory auditing (/doctor) which give limited undo/branch capability, but there is no documented versioning, review workflow, or rollback mechanism for 'automations' (agents/workflows) themselves — no agent version history, diffing, or restore-to-prior-version feature. missing for 10: agent/workflow version history, a review/approval process before changes take effect, and an explicit rollback-to-previous-version mechanism.
